full_text.ruling: NOT a licensed onset. The לכן-turn messenger formula with no addressee change and no verse-final close-role formula before it is an onset-class device (a messenger formula) that CUT-RULE does not license: it is the discourse turn from indictment to verdict inside one speech, which is what לכן does in Ezekiel's prose. The 'licensed as a discourse frame' category #e13 used at 17:19 does not exist; #e15 already withdrew it. A mark on the verse before corroborates the paragraph and licenses nothing. Addressee readings: 17:19 none (third-person king throughout 17:12-21); 20:30 none (house of Israel already the named audience at 20:27, and a title shift inside one audience group is not an addressee change — the P08-002 precedent); 39:25 none (same hearers as 39:21-24). Tier: the bytes MEASURED; the addressee findings are READINGS on measured bytes, stated as such.
full_text.consequence_for_the_scale: As a row's OWN onset near face this shape is the MEDIUM_LOW limb exactly as #e15 wrote it ('an own seam whose near face carries an onset-class device that is not licensed … whatever its far face carries'). As the FAR face of the preceding row's close seam it carries NO signal (a close far face carries a signal only when it carries a licensed onset or a scene change). As a RIVAL near face it is unlicensed; the rival is paragraph-grade unless its far face ends on a close-role signal, in which case it is two-faced-unlicensed and bars HIGH.
